 Search BTS Brings the ‘ARIRANG’ World Tour to Asia as Kaohsiung Turns Purple for ARMY
 riya siddacharjee 58 minutes ago 2 min read BTS is back on the road, and their latest stop is already looking like a massive celebration. The K-pop group officially kicked off the Asia and Australia leg of their ARIRANG world tour in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, on November 19 . But the excitement isn't limited to the stadium. 
 Kaohsiung prepares to welcome BTS and ARMY as the ARIRANG World Tour reaches Taiwan. ( @Btsworld62953/X) The entire city has joined in, turning purple to welcome RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, V, and Jungkook as they reunite with their fans across the region! Let's take a look at the excitement! 
 Kaohsiung Goes All Out to Welcome BTS and ARMY 
 Kaohsiung has pulled out all the stops for BTS , giving the city a full purple makeover. Major landmarks, including the 85 Sky Tower, Love River, Dagang Bridge, and Kaohsiung Music Center, have been illuminated in the group's signature color. 
 The celebrations have also made their way onto the streets. The 85 Sky Tower displayed special welcome messages, including 'THE CITY IS YOURS ARMY' and 'KH LOVES ARMY.' Some pedestrian traffic signals have even been updated with 'ARMY STOP' and 'ARMY GO' messages, complete with purple hearts. 
 BTS (Google) And that's not all. The city has introduced a special shuttle service called BUS 613 , a sweet nod to BTS' debut date of June 13 . A BTS-themed photo zone has also been set up at Kaohsiung International Airport, while concertgoers can enjoy special promotions at local shops and night markets. 
 The group is scheduled to perform at Kaohsiung National Stadium on November 19, 21, and 22 before heading to other Asian destinations. 
 BTS Takes ARIRANG Across Asia and Australia 
 Following Kaohsiung, BTS will take their tour to Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Jakarta, Hong Kong, and Bulacan in the Philippines. The group will also head to Australia in February 2027 for shows in Melbourne and Sydney. 
 For those who can't make it to the stadium, there's another way to catch the action. The November 21 Kaohsiung concert and December 29 Jakarta show will be screened in cinemas across more than 80 countries and regions. 
 Adding another highlight to their busy week, BTS also took home the Most Popular International Artist award at the 2026 ARIA Awards in Sydney on November 18. 
 With purple landmarks, BTS-themed surprises, and a packed tour schedule, the group's return to Asia is already off to a memorable start. And if Kaohsiung is anything to go by, ARMY has plenty more celebrations coming their way.
